_doc: PROMOTION-GATE SHRINK-GUARD acknowledgment ledger. The shrink guard derives, from git, whether this diff (a) drops a task out of the gated set — by deleting its promotion-pack.ts marker or its Prompts/canonical/manifest.json row — or (b) grows the grandfather baseline. Both directions mean the gate stops gating something, and both used to be completely silent (exit 0). They are now HARD ERRORS unless the change is deliberately recorded here, in the same diff. This ledger is NOT a mirror of the gated set (that stays derived); it records only the exceptions, so an out-of-date ledger cannot make the gate pass on something it should block. Entries that no longer match a real change are reported as STALE notes — remove them once they have landed, because a leftover acknowledgment pre-authorises a future removal. Shape: {kind: 'gated_set_removal' | 'baseline_addition', task, promotedHash (baseline_addition only), reason, acknowledgedAt}.
